subject.title: Generate secretref reference docs from secret target registry metadata

question: Which open SecretRef docs-generation PR should be the canonical implementation path for this issue?
rationale: Current main still has the reported generator gap, while two open pull requests attempt overlapping fixes with different scope, proof, and mergeability signals.

options.title: Refresh the broader proven PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89142 as the canonical path if maintainers are comfortable adopting it after conflict resolution and fresh proof.

options.title: Repair the same-author PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/91612 if maintainers prefer the issue author's smaller branch after it adds sufficient proof and resolves conflicts.

options.title: Request one replacement
options.body: Pause or close both overlapping branches and ask for one narrow generator/check PR if neither current branch is worth adopting.

recommendation.title: Refresh the broader proven PR
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89142 as the canonical path if maintainers are comfortable adopting it after conflict resolution and fresh proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent SecretRef docs stabilization work makes this the best available routing owner for choosing the implementation path.
